verification.manualSilhouetteReview: Central/outer open grass and shorelines remain visible; high tree silhouettes removed. Previously flagged forest_depths and forest_crossing floor locations are flat grass.
verification.sampleAudit: 9 color samples per floor cell, positive threshold 6/9, at least2-cell-center distance from original water; all4 revised forest assets and all5 winter assets have zero water-on-floor candidates. Winter dark-rock-on-floor candidates also zero.
verification.scopeLimit: Offline color screening and visual review; this is not an exact per-pixel proof nor native collision/occlusion QA. Original PNGs only; parent owns asset copying/upscaling and runtime integration.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production terrain-only forest map retexture. Input1 is the authoritative clean ground-only render, world64x44 exact aspect; Input2 is same-framing exact navigation stencil. Output2048x1408 or higher. Change surface materials only. Keep every ground, dirt trail, river edge and dark green blocked pixel island EXACTLY where Input1 shows it. No crop, reframe, rotate or reshape. This asset will have ALL tall trees and objects drawn separately at runtime. Absolutely NO tall tree trunks, individual standing trees, tall root ridges, raised tree canopies, rocks, buildings, ruins or props anywhere in this painting. In particular the small separated dark-green internal blocking islands at center and right MUST stay small and separate, no connecting or enlarging them into forests. Paint them only with FLAT dark moss and low soft undergrowth, never a tall tree crown. The surrounding large dark-green perimeter can be deep low contrast FLAT forest-floor moss with gently layered receding terrain shading strictly confined within the exact blocked footprint, still no standing trees or canopy in this terrain source. All lighter green open regions remain bright flat grass with restrained leaf patches. Dirt trail geometry unchanged, weathered warm ochre earthy paths, subtle embedded flatstones. Preserve small bottom pool including its thin isolated right-side sliver as in image1; water deep blue-green with narrow earthy banks. Elegant cohesive fine pixel art, emerald and olive grass, warm trails, shaded moss perimeter, restrained intentional clean clusters, stepped material value differences. No photorealism, blur, grain, edgeglow or heavy cast shadows. Do not fill open space with objects; flat clearings are deliberate because runtime props will supply depth. Image2 tan is playable and must remain FLAT and clear. No terrain crossing changes, no additional water, no deleted water. No text, labels, grid, symbols, UI or frame. Exact navigation registration is highest priority.
